name: bugreport
description: The bugreport tool must accept a title and description, format them into a structured body, map severity to a board priority, and post via the kanban_add cross-tool call — returning ok:true with a card_id. It goes red when the formatting path breaks, the severity mapping rejects valid input, or the cross-tool routing fails.
prompt: Use the bugreport tool with {"title":"eval smoke test","description":"the thing broke"}. Look at the tool's JSON result. If its ok field is true and a card_id field is present, reply with exactly CLEAN. Otherwise reply with exactly BROKEN.
